description: THE ROUNDING-MODE ANCHOR, AND THE ONE CASE ONLY RoundingMode.DOWN CAN PASS. COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 at app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl:464-465 is the only division in the whole estate and it carries NO ROUNDED phrase - the keyword appears ZERO times across all 28 programs in app/cbl, exhaustively verified - so the store into WS-MONTHLY-INT PIC S9(09)V99 at :168 TRUNCATES its excess fractional digits. In Java that is setScale(2, RoundingMode.DOWN): the scale is exactly 2 and the mode is truncation towards zero, decided in exactly one place, common.CobolDecimal, whose COBOL_ROUNDING constant every monetary path in this migration inherits (gates G23, G24). THE OPERANDS ARE CHOSEN SO THAT A WRONG MODE CANNOT PASS: 158.00 at 15.00 has an exact product of 2370.0000 and an exact quotient of 1.9750, which sits precisely ON the halfway boundary at the third decimal. Truncation gives 1.97; HALF_UP gives 1.98; HALF_EVEN gives 1.98 as well, because the retained digit 7 is odd and a half-even carry rounds it up too; CEILING gives 1.98. One assertion therefore falsifies three modes at once, and TRAN-AMT is 0000000019G and never 0000000019H - a run that reports 1.98 has not reproduced the COBOL, it has rounded where the COBOL truncated (gates G25, G28). Stated for precision rather than left implied: FLOOR also gives 1.97 here, because the quotient is positive and truncation towards zero coincides with rounding towards negative infinity on a positive value; FLOOR is falsified by case05, whose balance is negative. The pre-existing repository specification asserts HALF_EVEN for this very calculation; that assertion is superseded and incorrect, and this case is the artefact that catches it. OPERAND SCALE: DIS-INT-RATE is PIC S9(04)V99 in app/cpy/CVTRA02Y.cpy, so the rate is read at scale 2 as 15.00 - not 15 and not 0.15. Every scaled numeric in this estate is V99 and nothing else, so scale 2 is a property of the system rather than a choice of this case. THE KEY-WIDTH TRAP, CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: CVTRA02Y's DIS-GROUP-KEY is SIXTEEN bytes - DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID X(10) + DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD X(02) + DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD 9(04) - so DIS-INT-RATE occupies 1-based bytes 17-22 and reads 00150{. The genuinely SEVENTEEN-byte key is CVTRA01Y's TRAN-CAT-KEY, 9(11) + X(02) + 9(04), and because BOTH records total 50 bytes the slip is invisible by width alone: a seventeen-byte disclosure key would read the rate from bytes 18-23 and corrupt this case's entire premise. Confirmed at 17-22 against the copybook. WHAT THIS CASE ADDS THAT case03 STRUCTURALLY CANNOT, DOCUMENTED RATHER THAN LEFT AS A COINCIDENCE: case03 pins this same arithmetic and this same 350-byte image over ONE-ROW slices of each dataset, which is the right shape for a byte-image case but cannot assert a lookup at all. Here the other four datasets are the COMPLETE, 100% UNMODIFIED shipped fixtures - ACCTFILE all 50 rows of acctdata.txt at 300 bytes, XREFFILE and XREFFIL1 all 50 rows of cardxref.txt at 36, DISCGRP all 51 rows of discgrp.txt at 50 - so the truncated 1.97 is produced only if three resolutions all land: the keyed READ at :373 selects account 00000000002 out of fifty accounts, the ALTERNATE-key READ at :394-395 resolves card 0923877193247330 out of fifty cross-reference rows ordered by CARD NUMBER rather than by account id, and the spaces key built at :210-212 misses all FIFTY-ONE disclosure rows before the 'DEFAULT' retry lands on exactly one of them - not the A000000000 block and not the ZEROAPR block, each seventeen rows wide. A single-row DISCGRP cannot tell a retry that matched the right row from one that matched the only row present. NOT ASSERTED HERE, SAID PLAINLY: the S9(09)V99 range-extreme probe this file previously carried is not part of this content; the truncation guarantee it probed is asserted above at the exact-half boundary, which is the sharper discriminator, and case05 covers the negative direction. SEED PROVENANCE, AND THE ONE ROW THAT IS NOT VERBATIM FIXTURE DATA: TCATBALF is an OVERRIDE and is declared inline. All FIFTY balances in tcatbal.txt are 0000000000{ - a zoned positive zero - so interest over that fixture is 0.00 at every rate and the unmodified fixture cannot exercise truncation at all. The balance used here is not invented either: 158.00 is the REAL ACCT-CURR-BAL of account 00000000002 in acctdata.txt, whose bytes 13-24 read 00000001580{, so the value is fixture-DERIVED. The row is built to CVTRA01Y's own shape - account 00000000002, type 01, category 0001, the seventeen-byte TRAN-CAT-KEY - with TRAN-CAT-BAL 0000001580{ at bytes 18-28 and the trailing FILLER X(22) zero-filled exactly as every row of that fixture carries it, totalling 50 bytes. Presenting a modified row as fixture data silently is the specific failure practice B12 exists to prevent, so it is named here instead. THE ACCT-GROUP-ID CORRECTION, DOCUMENTED AND NOT ABSORBED: the folder brief states that account rows carry a group id that steers them into the DISCGRP A-block. They do not. Verified across all fifty rows against CVACT01Y, A000000000 sits in ACCT-ADDR-ZIP at 1-based 103-112 while ACCT-GROUP-ID at 113-122 is TEN SPACES on 50/50 rows. So MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID at :210 moves spaces, the READ at :416 is keyed '          ' + '01' + '0001', no disclosure row begins with a space so it misses with FILE STATUS '23', :418-419 display both disclosure-group lines, :422 tolerates '00' OR '23' so nothing abends, and :437 moves 'DEFAULT' into an X(10) receiver making the retry key 'DEFAULT   ', which 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE resolves at :444 to the single DEFAULT/01/0001 row, discgrp.txt row 17. That fallback is this program's fixture-faithful HAPPY PATH, not an edge case. THE CROSS-REFERENCE WIDTH: cardxref.txt rows are 36 bytes where CVACT03Y declares 50, the trailing FILLER X(14) being absent from the data, so both cross-reference paths declare CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 and parity.FieldDiffer supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time; the fixture itself is never edited (gate G16). XREFFILE and XREFFIL1 are seeded from the same fifty rows deliberately: app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:29-32 opens the base KSDS and an alternate-index PATH over that SAME cluster in one step, so they are two access paths over one cluster and not two datasets, and neither is expected to be mutated (gate G45). THE GENERATED RECORD: all fourteen CVTRA05Y spans are pinned BY NAME in copybook order AND the whole 350-byte image is pinned, which is two assertions rather than one - the named fields localise a failure to a single span, and the image proves the total width and therefore that the trailing FILLER X(20) was emitted as spaces at all (gates G17, G19, G20, G21; app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:39 is DCB=(RECFM=F,LRECL=350)). TRAN-ID is 2022071800000001 because ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX at :474 runs BEFORE the STRING at :476-480 and WS-TRANID-SUFFIX is PIC 9(06) VALUE 0 at :173, so the first generated identifier ends 000001 and never 000000; PARM-DATE is the ten characters of app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:22 PARM='2022071800' concatenated verbatim as character data and never parsed as a date, an exact 10 + 6 = 16 byte fit. TRAN-CAT-CD is 0005 and not '05  ': :483 moves the alphanumeric literal '05' into a PIC 9(04) numeric-display receiver, which right-aligns and zero-fills, and four bytes is what keeps every later offset correct. TRAN-DESC is the 24 bytes 'Int. for a/c ' - thirteen characters including its trailing space - plus the eleven-digit ACCT-ID, followed by 76 spaces, because STRING at :485-489 writes only the composed bytes and leaves the receiver tail untouched while common.FixedWidthCodec builds the record with every PIC X span space-initialised. NEGATIVE ASSERTIONS, ALL DELIBERATE: not one of the fifty ACCTFILE rows is rewritten, and every one is expected byte-identical to its seed so that 'the account master was not disturbed' is an assertion rather than an omission. 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is reached from :196 only on an account break with WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y', and with a single input record this IS the first break, so :198 merely flips the flag; its only other call site, the ELSE at :219-220, is unreachable dead code because the enclosing PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at :188 makes the IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' at :189 always true. ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT TO WS-TOTAL-INT at :467 therefore does run and leaves 1.97 in WS-TOTAL-INT, and that total is never applied to ACCT-CURR-BAL: the last account group's accumulated interest is a defect preserved verbatim, not repaired, and case13 owns the balance-addition path where a break is not the first one (the folder brief's pointer to case11 is stale - case11 is the second-'23' abend at RETURN-CODE 12). The truncated value is consequently observable ONLY through TRAN-AMT, which is why that one field is pinned so precisely. 1400-COMPUTE-FEES IS performed, at :216 inside the satisfied IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0 guard at :214, and contributes no record, no field and no message, because the paragraph at :518-520 is a header, the comment '* To be implemented' and EXIT - zero statements (gate G26). DETERMINISM: TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are the program's only wall-clock values and both take the same DB2-FORMAT-TS that Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP composes at :613-626 and :496-498 move. No 'now' is ever captured: a BATCH_JOB pins no clock of its own, so ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK applies, fixed at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 after the repository-wide source footer 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19', and rendering as the 26-byte 2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000. Bytes are US-ASCII throughout, matching the app/data/ASCII fixtures, never a platform default. Every dataset is addressed by its carddemo.datasets BINDING KEY and never by a dataset name, so no mainframe dataset name is written into this case at all (gate G46), and the unit is reached as a BATCH_JOB at step level through AccountInterestCalcJob.calculateInterest(String, SysoutSink), with no JobLauncher and no HTTP layer in the path (gate G51). PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the COBOL paragraphs cross-checked against the CVTRA01Y, CVTRA02Y, CVTRA05Y, CVACT01Y and CVACT03Y byte layouts, the INTCALC.jcl DD and PARM contracts and the real ASCII fixtures - and was never captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment (risk R-A). RULES: review_rules reports no user rules provided for this project; their absence is not permission to lower the bar, so this case is held to the plan's enterprise practices instead - B1 every literal concrete and verified, B3 the reference trees never written to, B4 both corrections above documented rather than silently applied, B5 dead code preserved, B7 a deterministic pinned clock, B8 scale, rounding mode, charset and row indexing all stated explicitly, B11 every offset read mechanically from a copybook, and B12 honest provenance for the one overridden row.
